summary: Unlock the secrets of effective retirement income planning with our Decumulation Training Course. Gain the skills to navigate your financial future confidently.
lede: Retirement decumulation planning turns accumulated assets into sustainable income while accounting for longevity, market and inflation risks. For financial planners, wealth managers and portfolio managers, the course covers scenario stress-testing, dynamic withdrawal design, income portfolio construction, tax-aware drawdown sequencing and evaluating annuities as a way to transfer risk.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for financial professionals who bear the responsibility of transitioning client wealth into sustainable retirement income. The curriculum speaks directly to practitioners managing complex distribution strategies.
modules: The Decumulation Landscape and Longevity Risk
Advanced Scenario Modeling and Stress Testing
Guaranteed Income and Risk Transfer Strategies
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of portfolio management, asset allocation principles, and basic tax structures. Familiarity with financial planning software or Excel-based financial modeling is highly recommended to engage fully with the quantitative modules. No advanced programming or coding skills are required.
